what_happened: Dispatch (2)/(5) require the new Z1 derivation to show 'propext at most' under #print axioms and to be a computable tree for the proof extractor. Measurement shows both are impossible in the DiscreteUnfolding style: Metalogic.Core.deductionTheorem is noncomputable and carries [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], solely because DeductionTheorem.lean installs Classical.propDecidable as a local instance and four haveI sites, even though Formula derives DecidableEq. Every derivation routing through it (dfSchema, succIndicator, coDerived, perpetuity5, perpetuity6) is pcq and noncomputable today.

Dispatch (3)'s consumer inventory for z1Thm is incomplete: it omits the second term-level shape pin in Metalogic/Independence/ArchimedeanSharpness.lean, four prose surfaces (Metalogic/Independence/README.md, Metalogic/Conservativity.lean, MinusLanguage/Axioms.lean, Semantics/FrameClassValidity.lean, Semantics/FrameProperty.lean, ProofSystem.lean, BimodalTools/AxiomNames.lean, Independence/StaticFrame.lean) and a second typst surface (typst/FormalFoundations.typ).

context/project/lean4/patterns/dependency-tracing.md's Shape 1 forward-closure probe classified every cited schema against the completeness engines in one lake env lean run against the existing oleans, and simultaneously exposed its own blind spot (imported theorem bodies are not serialised, so Prop-valued Derivable theorems are opaque to it) - which is exactly why the recipe's own warning about #print axioms mattered here.

The research report arrived with the per-schema audit, the corrected prune inventory, a probe-verified DeductionTheorem repair, and an explicit rewrite of the dispatch's unreachable acceptance criterion. Planning needed only confirmation greps, not re-derivation; every phase target was already named and verified.

The dispatch's item (2) acceptance criterion ('#print axioms showing propext at most') is unsatisfiable: three schemata the same dispatch names as model direct derivations (dfSchema, succIndicator, coDerived) already measure [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The plan substitutes a measured-profile-plus-no-engine-in-closure criterion and states the substitution in Non-Goals rather than silently planning against an impossible bar.

Phase 1's Scope Hypothesis (five classical-instance sites in DeductionTheorem.lean plus one noncomputable section in DiscreteUnfolding.lean) was insufficient: making coDerived/perpetuity5/perpetuity6 computable required stripping 59 further explicit 'noncomputable def/abbrev' markers across GeneralizedNecessitation, ModalDerived, ModalS4, ModalS5, TemporalDerived and Propositional/Reasoning, plus 34 in DedekindDerived/Principles/Interaction, plus 4 inert 'noncomputable section' wrappers, plus ~15 stale prose passages. The plan anticipated this as a signal that 'the cascade is wider than probed'; the sweep was taken rather than the revert contingency because the full build and the scoped Theorems build both stayed green.

Phase 3's four past mirrors (prevIndicatorAt/prevIndicator, prevConj, unfoldBackwardSince, snceBotFalse) all compiled on the first attempt from the prevAllPast recipe -- time_reflection plus one reflect_time_*_eq normalization lemma each, every one closed by a single simp only. The research report's prediction that the mirrors are free held exactly; the only diagnostic was one unused simp argument.

Phase 4's Scope Hypothesis said the Z1 derivation needs no helper beyond Phase 3's four mirrors. It needed two more, plus one new import. The route's step 2 (strengthening the UZ event from Gphi to Gphi and phi using the hypothesis G(Gphi->phi)) requires temporal K-distribution, which lives in Theorems/TemporalDerived.lean -- a module DiscreteUnfolding.lean did not import. The route's steps inside the witness also need past-mirror forms of necG and eventMono. Resolution: added 'import FormalSystem.Theorems.TemporalDerived' (no cycle: only FormalSystem.lean, Theorems.lean and MinusLanguage/AxiomDischarge.lean import DiscreteUnfolding), and named the two helpers necH and snceEventMono in Combinators.lean beside their future-direction primaries, per the plan's 'name rather than inline' obligation. The research sketch's US payload (not-Gphi) needed no adjustment.
